issues.description: Method Bitmap24::save: in both the template and solution, the header declares the method as 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) while the source implements it as 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)' (example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp). This return-type mismatch between declaration and definition will produce a compilation/linkage error when building the example_program (the Makefiles compile these files), blocking students from successfully building and running the project.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and implementation signatures match. Preferred: change the declaration in both example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp files to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' to match the existing implementations. Alternatively, change the implementations to return an int and return an appropriate status code, and update callers. Apply the same change consistently in both the template and solution repositories so the example program builds.

issues.description: Method return-type inconsistency for Bitmap24::save: the template header declares the method as 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' (template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp, lines 47-49) while the template implementation defines it as 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)' (template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp, lines 78-86). The solution header declares 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' (solution/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp, lines 47-49). This mismatch between the template header and both the template implementation and the solution header can cause compilation errors or confuse students about the expected API and return value semantics.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header match the implementation and solution: change the declaration in template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' so the API is consistent across header, implementation, and solution.
